text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on
the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Good day. I am Kawakami Princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll be needing you—a legendary trainer
in the
making—to lend me your strength
so I can
become a magnificent, elegant,
and gallant
princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And don't you worry! I'll pulverize any
obstacle
that gets in my way with my
Princess☆Kick!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
